An S4 class for prevalent new-user study data

Source: R/PnuData.R
PnuData-class.Rd

`PnuData` extends `CovariateData` (from FeatureExtraction) and is the central data container passed between all analytical steps. Like `CovariateData`, it is backed by an Andromeda (DuckDB) database and holds its tables as database tables accessed via the `$` operator, not as S4 slots.

Core tables (in addition to the covariates / covariateRef / analysisRef tables inherited from `CovariateData`):

| Table | Key columns | |—|—| | `cohorts` | `row_id`, `person_seq_id`, `person_id`, `cohort_start_date`, `cohort_end_date`, `treatment`, `exposure_set_id` | | `outcomes` | `person_seq_id`, `outcome_id`, `outcome_date` | | `exposureSets` | `person_seq_id`, `exposure_set_id`, `days_on_a` |

`treatment` = 1 for switchers (target), 0 for comparators. `exposure_set_id` = 0 means no prior treatment A (equivalent to ACNU).

Create with [createEmptyPnuData()] (internal) or [getDbPnuData()] (Step 3.1).

Usage

# S4 method for class 'PnuData'
show(object)

Arguments

object

A `PnuData` object.

Methods (by generic)

  • show(PnuData): Print a concise summary of a PnuData object.

References

Suissa S, Moodie EE, Dell'Aniello S. Prevalent new-user cohort designs for comparative drug effect studies by time-conditional propensity scores. *Pharmacoepidemiol Drug Saf* 2017;26(4):459-468. doi:10.1002/pds.4117
